items.name: NETFLIX DVD-BY-MAIL
items.image_alt: Monochrome illustration of a postal DVD sleeve, disc, and residential mailbox
items.epitaph: Five billion red envelopes taught the mailbox how to compete with the video store.
items.why: Streaming replaced physical delivery, leaving the original subscription service as a shrinking side business.
items.afterlife: Discs, envelopes, queues, and memories remain after the streaming service outlived its postal ancestor.
items.note: The DVD-by-mail service began in 1998 and mailed its final discs on 29 September 2023. Netflix streaming continued.
